11/21/2001: Phone Line Repaired: 
 
            - Field visit by Jeff Andresen.  Changed the phone line 
              connections and now able to collect data remotely. 
         
            - Collected data on campus and updated MAWN database  
              tables. 
 
            - Recent troubles allowed data buffer to fill and 
              some data was lost.  Data is missing between (and 
              including) the following dates: 
 
                 Day: 234, Time: 1715 (Aug 22, 5:15pm) 
                 Day: 307, Time: 1650 (Nov 03, 4:50pm) 
 
            - Needs: 
 
                 Current setup is not safe (grounded) from lightning. 
                 Will need to schedule a visit before next summer to 
                 properly ground phone/modem connections. 
 
 
 
11/01/2001: Field Visit (Jeff Andresen & Jim Brown): 
 
            - Phone line still giving troubles.  Test jack does 
              not produce a dial tone.  Connecting phone line 
              directly into modem only produces a strange tone 
              with clicking sounds. 
 
            - Installed Pressure sensor.  However, no changed made 
              to datalogger program so pressure is currently not 
              being recorded. 
 
 
 
08/02/2001: Phone Line Activated and Data Collection Started: 
 
               Phone Number:  (see setup notes) 
 
 
            Large gap in data was created between the time the 
            station was setup and the time that the phone line 
            was activated.  Due to this, the database tables  
            were rebuilt using the following as the start of 
            the the data archive: 
 
               24 hour data:  24:00, Day=197 (07/16/2001) 
               60 min data:  01:00, Day=197 (07/16/2001) 
               05 min data:  00:05, Day=197 (07/16/2001)
